global_notes: Gemini-API official docs currently do not support mode=video with file_ids.
The current Docker runtime is a locally patched experimental backend that accepts file_ids, but multi-image role binding is unreliable.
Do not assume multiple uploaded images are understood as separate storyboard, character, location, and temporal references.
For Gemini experimental I2V, prefer a single strong storyboard image as the visual source of truth. Use character and location references upstream when generating storyboard frames.
Use rejected_video_outputs.json to prevent failed variants from becoming the selected latest clip.

shots.reason: A multi-reference Gemini experimental run drifted into market/bowl/poverty imagery and no longer matched the Nanji Mountain mission-transfer storyboard.
